description: Pause, resume, cancel, retry or clarify a selected instruction task. The control record lets the executing agent acknowledge the change.

action.description: Requested control operation for the selected instruction task.

executionId.description: Execution record.id from begin_agent_execution when associating this call with an existing execution; not a session or project ID.

expectedVersion.description: Current version of the target record from its latest read or mutation result. A stale value causes a version conflict; re-read before retrying.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reuse the same key and identical payload only to retry the same mutation; use a new key for a new action.

projectId.description: Owned project ID returned by list_linked_projects or map_project; do not use a local path or repository URL.

sessionId.description: Active session record.id from start_agent_session for this project. Pass it on later project calls after starting the session.

taskId.description: Existing instruction task ID returned by inbox_list or task creation; distinct from a queue item or session ID.

text.description: Text accompanying the task control action, such as a clarification.

name: control_instruction_task
